methodology.scope: Selected implanted, minimally invasive, and implant-adjacent BCI companies with at least one publicly sourced financing of $2m or more.
methodology.coverage: Selected public financing records, including explicitly labeled philanthropic commitments. Combined multi-round disclosures are counted once at their published total. Associated capital sums the full financing amounts for records naming each backer; individual contributions require separate evidence. Dates identify announcements, reports or documented events; uncertain dates are labeled unverified. Amounts retain the published currency and historical exchange-rate estimates. Each saved conversion keeps its original rate and date; older estimates retain any unresolved rate-source qualifications. Company histories and source access remain partial. Standalone grants and lifetime cumulative totals remain outside the indexed sum.
